an6.29:1.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Udāyiṃ āmantesi
an6.29:1.3: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Udāyi tuṇhī ahosi.
an6.29:1.4: Dutiyam pi kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Udāyiṃ āmantesi
an6.29:1.6: Dutiyam pi āyasmā Udāyi tuṇhī ahosi.
an6.29:1.7: Tatiyam pi kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Udāyiṃ āmantesi
an6.29:1.9: Tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Udāyi tuṇhī ahosi.
an6.29:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmantaṃ Udāyiṃ etad avoca
an6.29:2.4: Idha bhante bhikkhu anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, seyyathīdaṃ ekam pi jātiṃ dve pi jātiyo . . . pe . . . iti sākāraṃ sa-uddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
an6.29:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ āmantesi
an6.29:3.3: "nevāyaṃ Udāyi moghapuriso adhicittam anuyutto viharatī" ti.
an6.29:3.4: Kati nu kho Ānanda anussatiṭṭhānānānī' ti?
an6.29:4.3: Idha bhante bhikkhu vivicc'eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an6.29:4.4: Idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya saṃvattati. 3.
an6.29:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhante bhikkhu ālokasaññaṃ manasikaroti, divāsaññaṃ adhiṭṭhāti: yathā divā tathā rattiṃ, yathā rattiṃ tathā divā.
an6.29:5.2: Iti vivaṭena cetasā apariyonaddhena sappabhāsaṃ cittaṃ bhāveti.
an6.29:5.3: Idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ ñāṇadassanapaṭilābhāya saṃvattati. 4.
an6.29:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhante bhikkhu imam eva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adhokesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati
an6.29:6.2: ‘atthi imasmiṃ kāye kesā lomā nakhā dantā taco maṃsaṃ nahārū aṭṭhī aṭṭhimiñjaṃ vakkaṃ hadayaṃ yakanaṃ kilomakaṃ pihakaṃ papphāsaṃ antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ pittaṃ semhaṃ pubbo lohitaṃ sedo medo assu vasā khelo siṅghāṇikā lasikā muttan' ti.
an6.29:6.3: Idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ kāmarāgassa pahānāya saṃvattati. 5.
an6.29:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhante bhikkhu seyyathā pi passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ ekāhamataṃ vā dvīhamataṃ vā tīhamataṃ vā uddhumātakaṃ vinīlakaṃ vipubbakajātaṃ,
an6.29:7.2: so imam eva kāyaṃ evaṃ upasaṃharati
an6.29:7.3: ‘ayam pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃ-anatīto' ti;
an6.29:8.1: seyyathā pi vā pana passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ kākehi vā khajjamānaṃ kulalehi vā khajjamānaṃ gijjhehi vā khajjamānaṃ suvānehi vā khajjamānaṃ sigālehi vā khajjamānaṃ vividhehi vā pāṇakajātehi khajjamānaṃ,
an6.29:8.2: so imam eva kāyaṃ evaṃ upasaṃharati
an6.29:8.3: ‘ayam pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃ-anatīto' ti;
an6.29:9.1: seyyathā pi vā pana passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nahārusambandhaṃ,
an6.29:9.4: aṭṭhikāni apagatasambandhāni disā vidisā vikkhittāni aññena hatthaṭṭhikaṃ aññena pādaṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅghaṭṭhikaṃ aññena ūruṭṭhikaṃ aññena kaṭiṭṭhikaṃ aññena piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ, so imam eva kāyaṃ evaṃ upasaṃharati ‘ayam pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃanatīto' ti; seyyathā pi vā pana passeyya sarīraṃ sīvathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhikāni setāni saṅkhavaṇṇūpanibhāni, aṭṭhikāni puñjakatāni, aṭṭhikāni terovassikāni pūtīni cuṇṇakajātāni,
an6.29:9.5: so imam eva kāyaṃ evaṃ upasaṃharati
an6.29:9.6: ‘ayam pi kho kāyo evaṃdhammo evaṃbhāvī evaṃ-anatīto' ti.
an6.29:9.7: Idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ asmimānasamugghātāya saṃvattati. 6.
an6.29:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhante bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā . . . pe . . . catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an6.29:10.2: Idaṃ bhante anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ anekadhātupaṭivedhāya saṃvattati.
an6.29:10.3: Imāni kho bhante pañca anussatiṭṭhānānī ti. 7.
an6.29:11.2: tena hi tvaṃ Ānanda idam pi chaṭṭhaṃ anussatiṭṭhānaṃ dhārehi:
an6.29:11.3: idh' Ānanda bhikkhu sato 'va abhikkamati, sato 'va paṭikkamati, sato 'va tiṭṭhati, sato 'va nisīdati, sato 'va seyyaṃ kappeti, sato 'va kammaṃ adhiṭṭhāti.
an6.29:11.4: Idaṃ Ānanda anussatiṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ bhāvitaṃ evaṃ bahulīkataṃ satisampajaññāya saṃvattatī ti. 1.
